```scl
FUNCTION_BLOCK "Solar_Tracker_Controller"
VERSION : 0.1
   VAR_INPUT
      SysTime : DTL; // System date and time
      WindSpeed : REAL; // Current wind speed (m/s)
      PV_Voltage : REAL; // PV string voltage (V)
      PV_Current : REAL; // PV string current (A)
      WindLimit_Stow : REAL := 15.0; // Wind speed threshold for stow (m/s)
   END_VAR
   VAR_OUTPUT
      TrackerAngle : REAL; // Output tracker angle (-90 to +90 deg)
      MPPT_Power : REAL; // Calculated active power (W)
      Stow_Active : BOOL; // True if wind stow is active
   END_VAR
   VAR
      DayOfYear : INT;
      HourAngle : REAL;
   END_VAR
BEGIN
   // MPPT Metrics Calculation
   #MPPT_Power := #PV_Voltage * #PV_Current;
   
   // Wind Stow Safety Mode
   IF #WindSpeed >= #WindLimit_Stow THEN
      #Stow_Active := TRUE;
      #TrackerAngle := 0.0; // Stow flat
   ELSE
      #Stow_Active := FALSE;
      // Simplified Sun Ephemeris Calculation
      #HourAngle := (12.0 - USINT_TO_REAL(#SysTime.HOUR)) * 15.0;
      #TrackerAngle := #HourAngle; // Simplified single-axis tracking based on hour angle
   END_IF;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```

```scl
FUNCTION_BLOCK "FlotationCell_Base"
VERSION : 0.1
   VAR_INPUT 
      StartCmd : Bool;   // Start command for the cell
      Level_PV : Real;   // Froth level process value from ultrasonic sensor (0.0 - 100.0 %)
      Level_SP : Real;   // Froth level setpoint (0.0 - 100.0 %)
      Dosing_SP : Real;  // Reagent dosing setpoint (L/hr)
   END_VAR

   VAR_OUTPUT 
      Valve_CV : Real;   // Control value for level discharge valve (0.0 - 100.0 %)
      DosingPump_Cmd : Bool; // Command to run dosing pump
      DosingPump_Speed : Real; // Speed reference for dosing pump (0.0 - 100.0 %)

      instPID : "PID_Compact"; // PID instance for level control
      Running : Bool;
   END_VAR

BEGIN
    // Main state
    #Running := #StartCmd;

    // Froth Level PID Control
    #instPID(Setpoint := #Level_SP,
             Input := #Level_PV,
             ManualEnable := NOT #Running,
             ManualValue := 0.0,
             Output => #Valve_CV);

    // Reagent Dosing Logic
    IF #Running THEN
        #DosingPump_Cmd := TRUE;
        #DosingPump_Speed := #Dosing_SP; 
    ELSE
        #DosingPump_Cmd := FALSE;
        #DosingPump_Speed := 0.0;
    END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```

```pascal
FUNCTION_BLOCK "HVDC_Control"
VERSION : 1.0
VAR_INPUT
    SetAlpha : REAL; // Firing angle setpoint (degrees)
    GridVolt : REAL; // Grid voltage measurement
    GridFreq : REAL; // Grid frequency measurement
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    AlphaOut : REAL; // Actual firing angle
    FilterSync : BOOL; // Harmonics filter sync status
END_VAR
VAR
    AlphaFiltered : REAL;
END_VAR
BEGIN
    // Simple filtering and output
    AlphaFiltered := (AlphaFiltered * 0.9) + (SetAlpha * 0.1);
    AlphaOut := AlphaFiltered;
    
    // Harmonics filter synchronization logic based on frequency
    IF GridFreq > 49.8 AND GridFreq < 50.2 THEN
        FilterSync := TRUE;
    ELSE
        FilterSync := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```

Here is a Siemens SCL program implementing the basic logic for Moving Block CBTC and point machine switching:

```pascal
FUNCTION_BLOCK "CBTC_Moving_Block"
VERSION : 1.0
VAR_INPUT
    Train_Position : REAL;   // Position of the current train [m]
    Train_Speed : REAL;      // Current speed [m/s]
    Ahead_Train_Pos : REAL;  // Position of the train ahead [m]
    Switch_Req : BOOL;       // Request to switch point machine
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    Target_Speed : REAL;     // Calculated target speed [m/s]
    Brake_Apply : BOOL;      // Emergency brake command
    Switch_Pos : INT;        // Point machine position (0: Normal, 1: Reverse)
END_VAR

VAR
    Safety_Margin : REAL := 50.0; // Margin in meters
    Stopping_Dist : REAL;
END_VAR

BEGIN
    // 1. Moving Block Train Separation
    // Calculate stopping distance based on max deceleration (e.g., 1.5 m/s^2)
    Stopping_Dist := (Train_Speed * Train_Speed) / (2.0 * 1.5);
    
    IF (Train_Position + Stopping_Dist + Safety_Margin) >= Ahead_Train_Pos THEN
        Brake_Apply := TRUE;
        Target_Speed := 0.0;
    ELSE
        Brake_Apply := FALSE;
        Target_Speed := 20.0; // Max permitted speed
    END_IF;

    // 2. Point Machine Switching
    IF Switch_Req AND (Train_Speed < 0.1) THEN
        Switch_Pos := 1; // Reverse
    ELSIF NOT Switch_Req AND (Train_Speed < 0.1) THEN
        Switch_Pos := 0; // Normal
    END_IF;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```

```pascal
PROGRAM PRG_LightingControl
VAR
    fbPID : FB_BasicPID;
    fAmbientLightLevel : REAL; (* Lux from sensor *)
    fTargetLightLevel : REAL := 500.0; (* 500 Lux target *)
    fPIDOutput : REAL;
    
    aDALI_Ballasts : ARRAY[1..64] OF BYTE; (* DALI control levels *)
    i : INT;
    bEnable : BOOL := TRUE;
END_VAR

// Daylight Harvesting PID
fbPID(
    fSetpoint := fTargetLightLevel,
    fActualValue := fAmbientLightLevel,
    bReset := FALSE,
    fKp := 0.5,
    fTn := 2.0,
    fTv := 0.0,
    fOutMaxLimit := 100.0,
    fOutMinLimit := 0.0,
    fCtrlOutput => fPIDOutput
);

// DALI Sync
IF bEnable THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 64 DO
        aDALI_Ballasts[i] := REAL_TO_BYTE(fPIDOutput * 2.55); // 0-100 to 0-255 DALI scale
    END_FOR
END_IF
```

FUNCTION_BLOCK "CRAC_Control"
{ S7_Optimized_Access := 'TRUE' }
VERSION : 1.0
   VAR_INPUT 
      Enable : Bool;   // Start/Stop command
      DeltaP_Sensor : Real;   // Differential pressure between hot/cold aisle [Pa]
      DeltaP_SP : Real;   // Differential pressure setpoint [Pa]
      ReturnAir_Temp : Real;   // Return air temperature [degC]
      SupplyAir_Temp : Real;   // Supply air temperature [degC]
      Temp_SP : Real;   // Temperature setpoint [degC]
   END_VAR

   VAR_OUTPUT 
      Fan_Speed : Real;   // VFD Fan Speed [0.0 - 100.0 %]
      Cooling_Valve : Real;   // Chilled water valve position [0.0 - 100.0 %]
      Running : Bool;   // System running status
   END_VAR

   VAR 
      instPID_DeltaP : "PID_Compact";
      instPID_Temp : "PID_Compact";
   END_VAR

BEGIN
	#Running := #Enable;
	
	// Differential Pressure Control (Fan Speed)
	#instPID_DeltaP(Setpoint := #DeltaP_SP,
	                Input := #DeltaP_Sensor,
	                Reset := NOT #Running,
	                Output => #Fan_Speed);
	
	// Temperature Control (Cooling Valve)
	#instPID_Temp(Setpoint := #Temp_SP,
	              Input := #ReturnAir_Temp,
	              Reset := NOT #Running,
	              Output => #Cooling_Valve);
	
	IF NOT #Running THEN
	    #Fan_Speed := 0.0;
	    #Cooling_Valve := 0.0;
	END_IF;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

```iecst
PROGRAM MAIN
VAR
    rRoomPressure : REAL; (* Current room pressure in Pa *)
    rTargetPressure : REAL := 2.5; (* Target positive pressure for isolation *)
    rSupplyAirflow : REAL; (* CFM *)
    rReturnAirflow : REAL; (* CFM *)
    rRoomVolume : REAL := 150.0; (* m^3 *)
    rACH : REAL; (* Air changes per hour *)
    rTargetACH : REAL := 20.0; (* Required ACH for OR *)
    
    fbPressurePID : FB_BasicPID;
    fbACH_Controller : FB_BasicPID;
    
    rSupplyDamperCmd : REAL; (* 0-100% *)
    rReturnDamperCmd : REAL; (* 0-100% *)
END_VAR

// Calculate current ACH
rACH := (rSupplyAirflow * 60.0) / rRoomVolume;

// Control Room Pressure (Isolation)
fbPressurePID(
    fSetpoint := rTargetPressure,
    fActualValue := rRoomPressure,
    fKp := 1.5,
    fKi := 0.5,
    fKd := 0.1,
    fOutput => rReturnDamperCmd
);

// Control ACH
fbACH_Controller(
    fSetpoint := rTargetACH,
    fActualValue := rACH,
    fKp := 2.0,
    fKi := 0.8,
    fKd := 0.05,
    fOutput => rSupplyDamperCmd
);
```

Write a Siemens SCL program for a Flare Gas Recovery System controlling Compressor Surge Control and Seal Gas Pressure.

```scl
FUNCTION_BLOCK "FGRS_Control"
VERSION : 0.1
VAR_INPUT
    Compressor_Flow : REAL; // Current compressor flow
    Compressor_Discharge_Press : REAL; // Discharge pressure
    Seal_Gas_Press : REAL; // Seal gas pressure
    Seal_Gas_Setpoint : REAL; // Target seal gas pressure
    Surge_Flow_Limit : REAL; // Flow limit for surge
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Anti_Surge_Valve : REAL; // Anti-surge valve position (0-100%)
    Seal_Gas_Valve : REAL; // Seal gas valve position (0-100%)
END_VAR
VAR
    PID_Surge : "PID_Compact";
    PID_Seal : "PID_Compact";
END_VAR
BEGIN
    // Surge Control Logic
    // Open anti-surge valve if flow drops below limit relative to discharge pressure
    PID_Surge(Setpoint := Surge_Flow_Limit,
              Input := Compressor_Flow,
              Output => Anti_Surge_Valve);

    // Seal Gas Pressure Control
    // Maintain seal gas pressure at setpoint
    PID_Seal(Setpoint := Seal_Gas_Setpoint,
             Input := Seal_Gas_Press,
             Output => Seal_Gas_Valve);
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```
